lesson_subject: FortiOS 8.0 FortiGuard server preference, RTT-based selection and multi-server load balancing
feature_mechanism_fingerprint: Public/custom FortiGuard candidate pools; service-type overrides; RTT ordering; round-robin across up to five first-choice servers; default load-balance-servers 1->5.
workflow_transaction_fingerprint: Build service-specific candidate list -> order public/custom -> choose first candidates -> round-robin requests -> fallback according to preference.
failure_class: FortiGuard endpoint reachability or upgrade-induced candidate-pool change.
evidence_pattern: FortiGuard server View Details; show full system central-management; load-balance-servers; update/rating service status.
remediation_path: Set intended preference; define custom server types; preserve explicit pool count; test DNS/routes/ports; account for FortiGate Cloud constraints.
question_fingerprint: Candidate ordering vs service type vs load-balancing pool vs subscription failure.
diagram_topology_layout_fingerprint: FortiGate control plane fans to public/custom server pools, then service-specific update/rating/IoT/virtual-patching branches.
uniqueness_rationale: No prior FortiGate lesson covers FortiGuard server preference, RTT sorting or load-balance default.

lesson_subject: FortiManager 8.0 local-user per-device mapping for branch-specific credentials and FortiToken bindings
feature_mechanism_fingerprint: One ADOM local-user identity has device-specific password and 2FA/FortiToken overrides.
workflow_transaction_fingerprint: Create local user -> add per-device mappings -> reference user in policy -> install -> each FortiGate receives its mapped authentication data.
failure_class: Wrong branch credential/token binding or mapping omitted from install.
evidence_pattern: User Definition; Per-Device Mapping entries; install preview/diff; target FortiGate local user/token state.
remediation_path: Verify ADOM/device mapping; preview installation; confirm user reference; verify local user and token on each target.
question_fingerprint: Global local-user object vs per-device credential rendering.
diagram_topology_layout_fingerprint: One FortiManager local-user parent fans into separate branch mapping objects and two FortiGate targets.
uniqueness_rationale: No historical FortiManager lesson covers local-user credential and token mapping per device.

lesson_subject: PostgreSQL-to-ClickHouse analytics migration, migration-state validation and archive-backed rebuild boundary
feature_mechanism_fingerprint: Schema upgrade precedes PostgreSQL-to-ClickHouse migration; ClickHouse compression and hcache regeneration change disk footprint; archive logs are rebuild source.
workflow_transaction_fingerprint: Upgrade/schema -> migration -> ClickHouse queries; if gaps proven, validate archives/quota then rebuild all ADOM analytics from raw archive logs.
failure_class: Apparent data loss, migration still running, incomplete archive retention/quota, or confusion between migration and rebuild.
evidence_pattern: diagnose sql status rebuild-db; diagnose sql show db-size; diagnose test application logfiled 4 <adom>; oldest date; per-day log counts; archive availability.
remediation_path: Do not infer loss from disk size; wait for migration; compare date ranges/counts; verify archive retention/quota; schedule backup and all-ADOM rebuild only if gaps are proven.
question_fingerprint: Compressed database footprint vs missing data; migration vs rebuild.
diagram_topology_layout_fingerprint: Upgrade schema stage -> ClickHouse migration stage with raw archive retention path and conditional rebuild loop.
uniqueness_rationale: No prior FortiAnalyzer lesson covers PostgreSQL-to-ClickHouse migration; prior ClickHouse topics are FortiSIEM-specific.

lesson_subject: FortiSwitchOS 8.0 DNS-over-TLS and explicit resolver CA validation
feature_mechanism_fingerprint: Switch DNS client uses TLS TCP/853 with protocol dot; server-ca-cert enables CA validation; without CA, transport is encrypted but resolver identity is not verified.
workflow_transaction_fingerprint: Switch service lookup -> DNS request inside TLS -> resolver response -> cache; trust anchor validates resolver certificate when configured.
failure_class: DoT resolver/port mismatch, untrusted CA or false assumption that DoT alone authenticates the server.
evidence_pattern: config system dns; TLS handshake TCP/853; certificate chain; DNS response; server-ca-cert; cache limit/TTL.
remediation_path: Confirm resolver supports DoT; open TCP/853; import correct CA; set server-ca-cert; test certificate and DNS; account for cache-limit KB semantics.
diagram_topology_layout_fingerprint: FortiSwitch management DNS client to primary/secondary resolver over TCP/853 with separate CA trust branch and cache return.
uniqueness_rationale: No FortiSwitch lesson covers switch-originated DNS-over-TLS or resolver CA validation.

lesson_subject: Hotspot 2.0 WBA OpenRoaming ANQP advertisement and RADIUS WBA attributes
feature_mechanism_fingerprint: ANQP advertises roaming consortium OI; WBA profile adds provider and charging metadata; enterprise VAP uses RADIUS; FortiGate adds WBA vendor-specific attributes to Access-Request.
workflow_transaction_fingerprint: Client ANQP discovery -> association to enterprise VAP -> RADIUS Access-Request with WBA VSA -> identity provider authorization.
failure_class: Missing consortium advertisement, profile/VAP binding mismatch or missing WBA VSA.
evidence_pattern: ANQP OI list; hs-profile wba-open-roaming; VAP security/auth/radius/hotspot20 profile; RADIUS Type 26 Vendor 14122 subtypes 12-15.
remediation_path: Validate OI/provider IDs; bind ANQP to Hotspot profile; bind to enterprise VAP and WTP profile; inspect RADIUS packet.
diagram_topology_layout_fingerprint: Client discovery plane then association and FortiGate-to-RADIUS plane with WBA VSA branch.
uniqueness_rationale: Prior FortiAP topics cover CAPWAP, EAP, roaming and radio behavior but not WBA OpenRoaming ANQP/RADIUS attributes.

lesson_subject: FortiNAC 9.4 REST SMS Gateway request construction, HTTPS provider integration and visibility semantics
feature_mechanism_fingerprint: Service Connector sends SMS through provider API URL, method, content type, Basic Auth, HTTPS and form/header parameters; Enabled controls provider-list visibility only.
workflow_transaction_fingerprint: User selects provider/phone -> FortiNAC builds HTTP request -> provider API returns response -> output.master exposes request/response; Test Connection uses a selected user.
failure_class: Wrong URL/method/content type/headers/credentials/phone format, insecure HTTP or misunderstanding Enabled toggle.
evidence_pattern: Service Connector card; Test Connection; country-coded number; provider response; output.master; default gateway.
remediation_path: Use HTTPS; verify API method/URL/headers/content type/Basic Auth; include country code; save before test; inspect response; understand visibility semantics.
question_fingerprint: Gateway visibility vs send eligibility; API acceptance vs handset delivery.
diagram_topology_layout_fingerprint: FortiNAC user and connector feed request builder, HTTPS provider, response/debug branch.
uniqueness_rationale: No FortiNAC lesson covers REST SMS gateway request construction and provider visibility semantics.

lesson_subject: Persistent Agent certificate check: client proof, CA trust, CRL reachability and clock tolerance
feature_mechanism_fingerprint: Agent selects Local Computer Personal certificate, signs scan data, sends cert/signature/timestamp; server validates CA, SAN, Digital Signature key usage, optional CRL and five-minute clock skew.
workflow_transaction_fingerprint: Upload signer CA -> create Windows certificate custom scan -> add to compliance policy -> agent signs data -> FortiNAC validates trust/time/CRL -> compliance result.
failure_class: Missing/unreadable certificate, private key failure, SAN/CA mismatch, CRL unreachable, clock skew or unsupported CNG certificate.
evidence_pattern: WinCertCheck payload; agent logs; PersistentAgent debug/output.nessus; certificate store; SAN; Digital Signature usage; CRL URI; clocks.
remediation_path: Install cert in Local Computer Personal; ensure private key/Digital Signature; upload signer CA; validate SAN/domain join; test CRL reachability; sync clocks; avoid unsupported CNG certs.
question_fingerprint: Endpoint certificate absent vs server-side trust/CRL/time/signature rejection.
diagram_topology_layout_fingerprint: Endpoint cert store and signing feed FortiNAC validator with CA, SAN, CRL and clock checks converging on compliance.
uniqueness_rationale: Registry-scan and Secure Boot lessons do not cover client-certificate proof-of-possession and CRL/timestamp validation.

lesson_subject: FSSO Mobility Agent NTLM signing compatibility and endpoint-to-FortiAuthenticator identity transaction
feature_mechanism_fingerprint: Mobility Agent reports user/domain/interface/VPN IP over short-lived TCP sessions with PSK and keepalive; FAC resolves groups through LDAP or Entra OAuth and forwards filtered FSSO mappings.
workflow_transaction_fingerprint: Endpoint login/IP change -> Mobility Agent TCP identity exchange -> FAC group lookup -> FSSO filters -> FortiGate receives user-IP-group mapping; KB5135557 scenario reports NTLM signing negotiation failure.
failure_class: NTLM signing compatibility after Windows update or separate port/PSK/NTP/license/group lookup failure.
evidence_pattern: SSO Sessions source Mobility Agent; TCP/8001 capture; FSSO debug; agent log; NT_STATUS_MORE_PROCESSING_REQUIRED; license/session counts; NTP.
remediation_path: Separate transport from NTLM negotiation; verify port/PSK/NTP/license/LDAP; collect logs; unsigned NTLM workaround only as temporary approved exception; restore signing after supported fix.
question_fingerprint: A TCP session or NTLM error does not prove successful FSSO publication; isolate NTLM vs channel/lookup failures.
diagram_topology_layout_fingerprint: Endpoint Mobility Agent -> FortiAuthenticator -> LDAP/Entra group lookup -> FortiGate FSSO publication.
uniqueness_rationale: No prior FAC lesson covers Mobility Agent NTLM signing compatibility after the November 10, 2026 update.

lesson_subject: Associated-secret credential indirection and Smart Association username resolution
feature_mechanism_fingerprint: Primary secret holds target metadata; associated secret supplies credentials; Smart Association concatenates account prefix and logged-in username to resolve matching secret; Launch with selects credential source; SSH Auto-Switch controls final account.
workflow_transaction_fingerprint: Launch primary secret -> resolve static or Smart Association secret -> retrieve credentials -> authenticate target -> optional SSH account switch -> audit/approval.
failure_class: No matching generated username, inaccessible associated secret, incomplete credential fields or wrong SSH account-switch behavior.
evidence_pattern: Associated Secret mode; account prefix; generated username; Launch with selection; Auto-Switch Account; final session identity.
remediation_path: Verify generated username and permissions; keep all required fields in associated secret; choose current/associated source; enable Auto-Switch only when needed; verify target identity.
question_fingerprint: Target metadata vs credential source; associated-account login vs switch to primary account.
diagram_topology_layout_fingerprint: Primary secret metadata points to associated credential object; Smart Association lookup branch; launcher optionally switches account.
uniqueness_rationale: Prior FortiPAM topics cover JIT, multiple targets, TOTP and session transports, not associated-secret resolution.

lesson_subject: Bipartite user-workstation login anomaly detection and dynamic peer communities
feature_mechanism_fingerprint: Weighted bipartite graph of user/workstation login edges; training derives peer communities and similarity; low-scoring cross-community edge is anomalous.
workflow_transaction_fingerprint: Login report -> prepare -> train -> schedule inference/retraining -> score new edge -> incident with graph visualization.
failure_class: Sparse/stale baseline, high-degree service/admin users or shared workstations, unseen entities and poor threshold tuning.
evidence_pattern: ML Workbench job; train/test split; model quality; anomalies found; threshold; max node degree; convergence bound; schedule; incident graph.
remediation_path: Use representative login report; >70% training split; exclude high-degree nodes; tune threshold; retrain periodically; inspect unseen entities.
question_fingerprint: New user-workstation edge vs unusual count; high-degree/unseen-node exclusions.
diagram_topology_layout_fingerprint: Two-column bipartite user/workstation graph with weighted edges, peer communities, anomalous cross-community edge and incident path.
uniqueness_rationale: No recent FortiSIEM lesson covers bipartite login graph or peer-community anomaly scoring.

lesson_subject: EAP-TTLS LDAP authentication for IKEv2 IPsec agent tunnels
feature_mechanism_fingerprint: EAP-for-LDAP toggles EAP-TTLS for FortiSASE IPsec agent tunnels; IKEv2 LDAP authentication requires TLS-tunneled EAP credentials; private LDAP may route via SPA/BGP; LDAPS server identity checks protect credentials.
workflow_transaction_fingerprint: FortiClient provision -> IKEv2 tunnel -> EAP-TTLS credentials -> FortiSASE LDAP bind/search/group authorization -> tunnel access; private LDAP path via SPA hub.
failure_class: Unsupported client/tunnel profile, EAP toggle absent, LDAP bind/group lookup, LDAPS trust/identity or SPA route/policy failure.
evidence_pattern: FortiClient 7.4; EAP toggle scope; LDAP Test Connection; bind type/DN; server identity; SPA BGP route/policy; active tunnel.
remediation_path: Enable EAP only on supported IPsec profiles; verify FortiClient/tunnel type; test LDAP bind/search; use LDAPS CA/identity; confirm SPA routing and PoP policy.
question_fingerprint: SSL agent LDAP vs IKEv2 IPsec EAP-TTLS; authentication vs private-path reachability.
diagram_topology_layout_fingerprint: FortiClient IKEv2 EAP-TTLS to SASE PoP, SPA/BGP path to private LDAP, authorization response.
uniqueness_rationale: Recent FortiSASE topics cover Secure Browser, agentless ZTNA, telemetry and log forwarding, not EAP-TTLS LDAP for IKEv2.

lesson_subject: FortiOS 8.0 SD-WAN ISDB destination identity matching
feature_mechanism_fingerprint: ISDB internet-service-name/group/custom service is a destination classifier distinct from static address objects, application-control signatures, BGP route tags and DSCP.
workflow_transaction_fingerprint: Packet enters SD-WAN rule classifier -> ISDB maps destination IP/protocol/port to service identity -> ordered rule strategy selects member based on SLA/quality.
failure_class: Stale ISDB, overlapping service identity, mutually exclusive destination fields, confusing ISDB with application detection or rule-order/fallback issue.
evidence_pattern: SD-WAN destination fields; internet-service enable/name/group/custom; diagnose internet-service match/info; rule hit and selected member/SLA.
remediation_path: Verify ISDB database and match; use ISDB rather than dst when service identity is intended; distinguish application signatures; verify rule order and member SLA.
question_fingerprint: ISDB identity vs application-control classification vs manually maintained address objects.
diagram_topology_layout_fingerprint: Classifier branches for address, ISDB, application, route-tag and DSCP feed ordered SD-WAN rule/member selection.
uniqueness_rationale: Prior SD-WAN lessons cover application steering, route tags, SLA, duplication and load balancing; none covers ISDB as the destination identity source.
